notes.title: Sockventure - Developer livestream
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36645827/c3cfc9369d464595a81613f82d2b07d465e5c12a.jpg[/img]


[h2]Livestream[/h2]

Steam Game Festival is coming and Sockventure is participating! You are welcome to join us on our livestream as we play the game on May 17th.


[h2]About Sockventure[/h2]

Sockventure is a challenging 2D platformer game where you play as a Superhero Sockman and try to collect all the missing socks inside the cursed washing machine. We have released Sockventure: Prologue, a playable demo of the main game. Beat 50 levels of hardcore platforming, get new skills such as wall jumping, double jumping and dashing and bring the socks back safely. Unlock more challenging Dark World by collecting all the coins.
